people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Zippor
people.line: Father of Balak, king of Moab

translations.web: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
